tools.name: get_creation
tools.description: Check images or videos started with create_image or create_video: status, minutes left, and the finished link when ready. With wait true the call waits up to 40 seconds for them to finish, so you can wait for the result in the same answer and then give the user the link.

tools.name: list_creations
tools.description: List the user's latest MakeViral Create images and videos (newest first) with their status and links. Template runs are in list_runs.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the signed-in MakeViral account: its first name and credit balance. Every run uses credits, so use it before a run when the price might be more than the balance.

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Make a one-hour link where the user adds the photos for a template on makeviral.ai (on any device). Use it when the user cannot attach photos in this chat. Give the user the link, wait until they say they are done, then call run_template with the returned uploadId.

tools.name: suggest_template
tools.description: Send MakeViral a trend or idea that has no template yet, so the team can add it. Use it when search_templates finds nothing that fits what the user wants, and only after the user agrees. Include the TikTok or Instagram link of the trend when the user has one.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "run_template" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_video · Private data: run_template, create_image, create_video · Public sink: create_upload_link, suggest_template · Destructive: run_template, get_run, get_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_video · Private data: run_template, create_image, create_video · Public sink: create_upload_link, suggest_template · Destructive: run_template, get_run, get_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
